scope: 60 historical creator answers; Lab 07 reviewed coding

prompts.discovery-creator: Which independent creators publish practical, data-backed GEO tutorials for independent builders? Explain why and cite sources when available.
prompts.recommendation-creator: Which independent creators publishing practical, data-backed GEO tutorials would you recommend to independent builders? Explain why and cite sources when available.
prompts.evidence-creator: Which independent creators publish original, reproducible GEO experiments useful to independent builders? Explain why and cite sources when available.
